shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'for f in package.json next.config.ts tsconfig.json app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do echo "### $f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done

git status --short

git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json && git show HEAD:package.json && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && git show HEAD:next.config.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "test -d node_modules && echo node_modules-present || echo node_modules-missing
node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" 2>/dev/null || true
rg -n \"cacheComponents|Partial Prerender|Suspense.*uncached|Uncached data was accessed\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app tsconfig.json next.config.ts package.json wc -c .next/server/app/index.html for pattern in '

Dashboard

' 'Total Revenue' 'Total Invoices' 'Revenue' 'Latest Invoices' 'Loading revenue' 'Loading invoices'; do if rg -q -F \""'$pattern" .next/server/app/index.html; then echo "present: $pattern"; else echo "missing: $pattern"; fi; done rg -o '"'
|

Dashboard

|Total Revenue|Total Invoices|Loading revenue\\.\\.\\.|Loading invoices\\.\\.\\.|
' .next/server/app/index.html"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short
git diff --check
git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/CardStats.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx'

/bin/bash -lc 'nl -ba app/page.tsx
nl -ba app/loading.tsx
nl -ba app/CardStats.tsx
nl -ba app/RevenueChart.tsx
nl -ba app/LatestInvoices.tsx
git status --short'
